mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls by more than 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, it indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has fallen by more than 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic recovery, which is associated with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 forward returns are negative over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a potential recession, but this effect is only pronounced when the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past 6 months indicates sustained consumer spending growth, which drives corporate revenue and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS has been rising for 6 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market that increases household income and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days as the economy expands without monetary tightening, but this effect is absent when FEDFUNDS is above 1.0%.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.
